study type: Meta-analysis of a subgroup from randomized clinical trials
cohort: The study analyzed data from a subgroup of 173 infants delivered by Cesarean section from three randomized clinical trials.
finding: The administration of L. fermentum CECT 5716 significantly reduced the incidence of gastrointestinal infections by 73% in CS-born infants, but showed no statistically significant effect on respiratory infections.
